name: Corgi Kennel
description: The Welsh kennel club · real token art, three bonus games and Best in Show
css:
:root{color-scheme:dark;--green:#12392c;--deep:#091d17;--gold:#d6b774;--cream:#f5ebd5;--muted:#b9c2b2;--edge:#6f6b46}*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:transparent;color:var(--cream);font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif}button,input,select{font:inherit}button{cursor:pointer}button:disabled{opacity:.42;cursor:default}button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ffe7a8;outline-offset:3px}button{min-height:44px;border:1px solid #827047;border-radius:7px;color:var(--cream);background:#173c2f;padding:10px 16px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.02em}button:hover:not(:disabled){background:#28513f;border-color:#e5c78c}.primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffe7a7,#d0a44e);color:#15271b;border-color:#f4e5b6}.primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:#f3d797;color:#12291d}a{color:#e5c78c;text-underline-offset:3px}a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ffe7a8}button small{display:block;color:#c9d1c6;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.08em;font-weight:500;margin-top:4px}.primary small{color:#4a4e2d}[hidden]{display:none!important}.eyebrow{text-transform:uppercase;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.22em;color:#d6b774}.serif{font-family:Georgia,serif}#fullscreen{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:#071711}#screenStage{flex:1;min-height:0;min-width:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:8px}#screenStage canvas{display:block;max-width:100%;max-height:100%;object-fit:contain;border:1px solid #8b7449;border-radius:8px;touch-action:manipulation}#fullscreenBar{flex-shrink:0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;align-items:stretch;padding:6px max(6px,env(safe-area-inset-right)) calc(6px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) max(6px,env(safe-area-inset-left));background:rgba(7,21,16,.985);border-top:1px solid #6a5b38}#fullscreenBar button{padding:6px 8px;min-width:50px;flex:1 0 50px;min-height:48px;font-size:10px;white-space:nowrap}#fullscreenBar button.primary{min-width:94px;flex-grow:1.6;font-size:13px}#fullscreenBar button[aria-pressed=true]{border-color:#f3d797;background:#315240}#fullscreenBar .stat{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;padding:5px 8px;min-width:74px;flex:1 0 74px;border:1px solid #3b523f;border-radius:7px;background:#10271e}#fullscreenBar .stat small{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#b9c2b2}#fullscreenBar .stat strong{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-size:15px;color:#efd49a}#fullscreenBar .volume{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:62px;flex:0 0 64px;min-height:48px}#fullscreenBar input[type=range]{width:60px;min-height:44px;accent-color:#e3bb69}#fullscreenBar .feature-action{flex:1 1 100%;background:#d8bb74;color:#193221;font-size:14px}#previewStrip{background:#dec78e;color:#163523;padding:7px 12px;text-align:center;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.11em;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px}#previewStrip button{min-height:44px;padding:4px 10px;font-size:10px;border-color:#6f6b46;background:transparent;color:#153927}#modal{position:fixed;inset:0;margin:auto;width:min(850px,calc(100vw - 28px));max-height:min(85dvh,calc(100dvh - 28px));padding:0;border:1px solid #a88a4f;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 32px 100px #000b;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#14382b,#0b231b);color:var(--cream);z-index:100;overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain}#modal::backdrop{background:rgba(0,8,4,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(5px)}#panelShade{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,8,4,.55);z-index:90}#modal[open]{display:block}.panel-head{position:sticky;top:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:14px 23px 12px;background:#0f2c22f5;border-bottom:1px solid #73663f;z-index:2}.panel-head button{font-size:25px;padding:0;width:44px;min-height:44px;border:0;background:transparent}#panelContent{padding:24px 28px 30px}h1,h2,h3{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-weight:400}h2{font-size:36px;line-height:1.1;margin:0 0 15px}h3{font-size:23px;margin:24px 0 10px}p,li{font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;color:#d2d8cd}p{margin:10px 0 15px}ul,ol{padding-left:22px}table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:12px;margin:16px 0}th{text-align:left;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#d2b87a;padding:12px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid #988052}td{padding:10px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid #3b5543;vertical-align:middle}.num{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;text-align:right}td img{height:38px;width:38px;object-fit:contain;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:8px;border-radius:6px}code{font-size:10px;overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:break-word;background:#09251b;padding:3px 5px;border-radius:4px}.callout{border:1px solid #6c7048;border-left:3px solid #d9b56b;padding:16px 18px;border-radius:8px;background:#193e2b;margin:16px 0}.callout p{margin:0}.panel-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:20px}.panel-actions button{flex:1;min-width:120px}.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px}.choice{padding:16px;text-align:left;min-height:112px;background:#133426}.choice b{display:block;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:20px;font-weight:400;margin-bottom:8px}.choice small{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:0;line-height:1.45;font-weight:400;color:#c2ccbf}.choice.active{border-color:#e5c78c;background:#2b4b31}.form-row{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-end;margin:16px 0}.form-row label{display:flex;flex:1;min-width:120px;gap:8px;flex-direction:column;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#d9c699}input[type=text],select{width:100%;min-height:44px;border:1px solid #827047;background:#0a281c;color:#f4e5c1;border-radius:6px;padding:10px;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:0}input[type=checkbox]{width:20px;height:20px;accent-color:#d6b774}.chip-list{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}.chip-list span{border:1px solid #506247;border-radius:20px;padding:6px 10px;color:#d2d8cd;font-size:11px}.large-number{font:56px Georgia,serif;color:#efd49a;letter-spacing:-.03em}.fine{font-size:11px;color:#a7b8a4;line-height:1.6}.source-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:10px}.source{border:1px solid #526647;padding:12px;border-radius:8px}.source img{width:52px;height:52px;object-fit:contain;float:left;margin-right:12px}.source p{font-size:11px;margin:4px 0;clear:both}.source a{font-size:11px}#toast{position:fixed;left:50%;top:16px;transform:translateX(-50%);max-width:calc(100% - 30px);z-index:120;background:#e6d09d;color:#183a2b;padding:12px 18px;border:1px solid #fff1c4;border-radius:9px;box-shadow:0 8px 30px #0005;font-size:13px;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s}#toast.show{opacity:1}.sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}.lab-status{background:#08251b;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;white-space:pre-wrap;max-height:200px;overflow:auto}.switch-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #39543e}.switch-row label{font-size:14px}.switch-row input[type=range]{min-height:44px;accent-color:#d6b774;width:120px}.line-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:8px}.line-box{background:#08251b;border:1px solid #39543e;padding:4px;border-radius:5px;text-align:center}.line-box svg{width:100%;height:40px}.line-box small{font-size:10px;color:#b9c2b2}@media(max-width:600px){#panelContent{padding:20px 18px}h2{font-size:29px}.cards{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:7px}.choice{min-height:106px;padding:12px}.choice b{font-size:17px}.source-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.line-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}td,th{padding:9px 5px}td img{width:28px;height:28px;margin-right:4px}#fullscreenBar{gap:4px}#fullscreenBar button{flex:1 0 54px;min-width:54px;font-size:9px;padding:5px 5px}#fullscreenBar .stat{min-width:64px;flex-basis:64px}#fullscreenBar button.primary{min-width:86px;flex-basis:86px}#previewStrip{font-size:8px;padding:4px 6px;gap:6px}#previewStrip button{min-height:44px}#modal{max-height:calc(100dvh - 20px)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{scroll-behavior:auto!important;animation-duration:.01ms!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important}}

body > #featureBar { display: none; }
